title: An entropy bridge from weighted to spectral Turán theorems
summary: We establish an entropy bridge, and then use it to prove that for any color-critical graph $F$ with chromatic number $χ(F)=r+1\ge 3$, there exists a constant $λ_0=λ_0(F)$ such that if $G$ is an $F$-free graph with $λ(G)\ge λ_0$, then for every $\ell\ge 1$ with $(r,\ell )\neq (2,2)$, \[ λ^\ell (G) \le \Big(1-\frac1r\Big)w_\ell(G), \] with equality if and only if $G$ is a regular complete $r$-partite graph; in the case $r=2$ with $\ell$ even, equality holds for every complete bipartite graph.
